$comment: Which gates block a pull request. Every gate still runs: the ones not listed under pull_request run weekly and on demand in .github/workflows/gates-weekly.yml, and release.yml runs all of them over a candidate before promoting it. Decided on 2026-10-15 after an adversarial review found 37 gates on every pull request, most of them checking that the repository's own documents agree with each other, while the product they govern had never been measured. A gate belongs here when a defect it catches would reach a user who installs the plugin.
$comment_batteries: Batteries outside scripts/gates/ that prove what users run: the CLI and the shell guard. A gate's own battery follows the gate's set.
